outcome: the task's own tests/test.sh after the agent exited: reward.txt 1 = resolved

steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
for f in /app/alice_calendar.ics /app/bob_calendar.ics /app/carol_calendar.ics; do
  echo "===== $f ====="
  cat "$f"
done
EOF

sbx run <<'SCRIPT'
python3 - <<'PY'
lines = [
"BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
"VERSION:2.0",
"PRODID:-//MOCA//Meeting Scheduler//EN",
"CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
"METHOD:PUBLISH",
"BEGIN:VEVENT",
"UID:team-planning-20240117@example.com",
"DTSTAMP:20240117T000000Z",
"DTSTART:20240117T110000Z",
"DTEND:20240117T120000Z",
"SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting",
"DESCRIPTION:1-hour planning meeting for Alice, Bob, and Carol",
"LOCATION:Conference Room",
"ATTENDEE:mailto:alice@example.com",
"ATTENDEE:mailto:bob@example.com",
"ATTENDEE:mailto:carol@example.com",
"STATUS:CONFIRMED",
"END:VEVENT",
"END:VCALENDAR",
]
with open('/app/meeting_scheduled.ics','w',newline='') as f:
    f.write("\r\n".join(lines)+"\r\n")
print("written")
PY
echo "--- file ---"
cat -A /app/meeting_scheduled.ics | head -30
echo "--- validate ---"
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
txt=open('/app/meeting_scheduled.ics').read()
assert txt.startswith('BEGIN:VCALENDAR')
assert txt.rstrip().endswith('END:VCALENDAR')
assert 'VERSION:2.0' in txt and 'PRODID' in txt
m=re.search(r'BEGIN:VEVENT(.*?)END:VEVENT',txt,re.S)
d=dict(l.split(':',1) for l in m.group(1).strip().splitlines() if ':' in l)
s=datetime.strptime(d['DTSTART'],'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'); e=datetime.strptime(d['DTEND'],'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
print("summary:",d['SUMMARY'],"start:",s,"end:",e,"duration:",e-s)
atts=re.findall(r'ATTENDEE:mailto:(\S+)',txt)
print("attendees:",atts)
assert set(atts)=={'alice@example.com','bob@example.com','carol@example.com'}
assert e-s==timedelta(hours=1)
print("VALID")
PY
echo "--- input files unchanged (mtimes/sizes) ---"
ls -l /app/*.ics
